messages:
maria: heads-up — compliance run flagged ~1.2k missing role.grant events for 2026-03-10..2026-03-12 window. query + sample logs below, looks like audit-sink lag/drop. @jason can you take ingestion?

auditbot: Automated alert: audit-event-sampling anomaly detected for event_type=role.grant, delta= -1243 compared to baseline (7d avg).

jason: on it. do we have a reproducible query?

maria: yep — running a count against the primary audit db vs raw kafka offsets.

```sql
-- counts by day
SELECT date(created_at) as d, count(*) as grants
FROM audit_events
WHERE event_type = 'role.grant'
  AND created_at >= '2026-03-10'
  AND created_at < '2026-03-13'
  AND service = 'rbac'
GROUP BY d
ORDER BY d;
```

maria: results show 2026-03-10: 0 (expected ~400), 2026-03-11: 12 (expected ~380), 2026-03-12: 9 (expected ~420).

jason: ok that's consistent with what the sink metrics show — high consumer lag on audit-ingest in that period. pulling broker logs now.

```text
[2026-03-10T02:14:06Z] audit-ingest[pid=2312] WARN kafka: consumer group audit-ingest lag for topic audit-sink partition 14 = 12500
[2026-03-10T02:14:07Z] audit-ingest ERROR decrypt: kms decrypt failed for key_id=projects/prod/keys/audit-key: ResourceNotFound
[2026-03-10T02:14:07Z] audit-ingest ERROR processing message offset=413245: failed to decrypt message key
[2026-03-10T02:14:09Z] audit-ingest INFO consumer resumed after transient error
```

lee: kms ResourceNotFound during that window could be a rotated key or permissions. did we run the scheduled KMS rotation on 2026-03-10?

maria: Ops ran a key rotation at 02:10 UTC per runbook — they said it was staged/rolled back but trying to correlate.

jason: timeline: rotation start 02:10, some consumer instances (autoscaled ones) restarted 02:11-02:16, a subset couldn't access new key until 02:30 due to IAM propagation. During that 20min window, consumer retried & then resumed but seems messages dropped from compacted topic because retention/compaction timing overlapped with backlog.

sasha: if messages were removed by compaction, we need to backfill from archival S3. I can run the backfill script but need approval and an ETA for compliance.

maria: compliance deadline for this quarter's report is EOD 2026-03-25. we should mark this as P2 but treat as compliance blocker until backfill done.

jason: mitigation we applied: flipped feature flag to enable audit-sink-old-fallback (routes reads from legacy sink) at 02:40; that restored visibility for new events but doesn't recover historical missing entries.

```bash
# temporary mitigation
curl -X POST "$CONTROL_PLANE/api/flags" -d '{"flag":"audit-sink-old-fallback","value":true}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

lee: ask: do we have end-to-end test that exercises KMS during rotation? if not, add one to prevent regressions.

sasha: I'll start backfill job now. plan: read archived topic snapshots from s3://audit-archive/2026-03-10/part-* -> decrypt with new key -> reingest into audit_events (write mode=upsert). estimating ~3h.

maria: assign to sasha for backfill, jason to produce an incident blameless postmortem and harden consumer restart flow, lee to own compliance sign-off on the backfill.

jason: noted. I'll collect consumer metrics, offsets, and the KMS call traces for the postmortem. quick question — do we need a signed attestation for the compliance team after backfill?

maria: yes, compliance wants a signed CSV of recovered events + verification script output. sasha please output counts by event_id and md5 and upload to shared drive.

sasha: will do. starting job now, posting progress here every 30m.

auditbot: Backfill job sasha-backfill-20260310 started. job_id=bf-9082. estimated_time=180m.

maria: thanks — once we have the recovered rows we'll rerun the compliance queries and update the report.

lee: action items recap: 1) sasha run backfill & upload artifacts; 2) jason assemble postmortem + remediation (consumer retry backoff + pre-rotation healthcheck); 3) ops review KMS rotation runbook to avoid propagation gaps; 4) maria update compliance ticket.

jason: adding runbook change: delay compaction for audit-sink topics by 24h around any KMS rotation or have synchronous archival snapshot. I'll draft PR.

maria: perfect. keep updates here. :thumbsup:
